FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF CHEMISTRY
&
CENTRE OF ADVANCED STUDIES IN CHEMISTRY PANJAB
UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH – 160 014
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited from suitable candidates for the post of Senior Research Fellow (SRF) in the
DST- Water Technologies Cell Project entitled “Technology development for recovery and reuse of HCl
from industrial waste water” under the joint supervision of Prof. Ganga Ram Chaudhary, Department
of Chemistry (Principal Investigator) and Dr. Ramesh Kumar (Co-Principal Investigator), Department
of Sophisticated Analytical Instrumentation Facility (SAIF), Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Essential Qualification:
Master Degree in Chemistry/industrial chemistry/Chemical Engineering/Metallurgy with qualification
(a) National Eligibility Tests– CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship or GATE
or
(b) Qualified National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their
agencies and institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER,
NISER.
and
Two years of research experience in academia, industry or any other research project.
Preference will be given to the Ph.D. completed candidates
Number of Positions: 1 (one)
Fellowship:
Monthly emoluments of the fellowship shall be as per DST norms (42000 per month +18% HRA), the
duration of the fellowship is for the period of one year and then extended further based on the
performance of the candidate.
Selection process:
Eligible and shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview in the Department of Chemistry, Panjab
University, Chandigarh.
Applications along with Curriculum Vitae may be submitted to the undersigned by email latest by
January 15, 2024. To apply for this position please email grc22@pu.ac.in and mention in the subject
“Name-Application for post of SRF in DST-Water Technologies Cell project” The date and time of the
interview will be informed to the shortlisted candidates by email. No separate interview letters will be
issued and no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. The position is purely on temporary
basis and is coterminous with the project.
Prof. Ganga Ram Chaudhary
Department of Chemistry, Panjab University
Chandigarh-160014, Email:grc22@pu.ac.in
